t: There are hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, such sums as are necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.

fable.w: This is a bare authorization of appropriations to carry out the Act. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision. There is no tempting participation reading here; the section concerns funding only.
fable.s: There are hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, such sums as are necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard authorization of appropriations clause. It merely provides the legal authority for Congress to allocate funds to the executive branch to implement the Act. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government (such as the public, states, or private entities) in the decision-making process.
qwen_block.s: There are hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, such sums as are necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.

opus.w: This section only authorizes the money needed to carry out the Act. It requires no consultation, comment period, hearing, advisory committee, rulemaking, or right to sue for anyone outside the federal government. The general reference to 'the purposes of this Act' doesn't pull in processes from other sections, so it isn't participation.
opus.b: This is a plain appropriations authorization. One could be tempted to read "to carry out the purposes of this Act" as bringing in whatever processes the rest of the Act sets up. That reading doesn't hold up, because this section adds no consultation, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue. Nobody outside the federal government is involved.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard authorization of appropriations clause. It provides funding for the Act but does not itself establish any mechanism for public participation, consultation with outside entities, or advisory committees. It contains no procedural requirements involving parties outside the federal government.
qwen_chat.s: There are hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, such sums as are necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "carrying out the purposes of this Act" implicitly involves participation if the Act itself contains participation requirements. However, this specific section is merely an authorization of appropriations (funding). It does not describe any process, consultation, hearing, or interaction with outside parties. It is a standard boilerplate funding clause.
